description: This Java class 'SqlJdbcUtil' provides utility methods for constructing SQL clauses, handling JDBC data types, and binding values for database operations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY clauses, and for setting/getting values from ResultSet and PreparedStatement objects, with support for various data types and database-specific syntax.

classes.name: SqlJdbcUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for constructing SQL clauses, handling JDBC data types, and binding values within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makeFromClause
methods.description: Constructs the FROM clause, including JOINs, for a given ModelEntity, supporting view entities and different join styles.

methods.name: makeWhereStringFromFields
methods.description: Builds a WHERE clause string with conditions based on provided fields and operators.

methods.name: makeWhereClause
methods.description: Creates a complete WHERE clause, combining field conditions and view entity conditions.

methods.name: makeViewWhereClause
methods.description: Generates the WHERE clause for view entities, supporting different join styles like 'ansi' and 'theta'.

methods.name: makeOrderByClause
methods.description: Constructs an ORDER BY clause based on a list of fields.

methods.name: makeViewTable
methods.description: Creates a subquery for a view entity, including SELECT and FROM clauses.

methods.name: filterColName
methods.description: Sanitizes column names by replacing special characters with underscores.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Binds a list of ModelFields' values to an SQL statement via SQLProcessor.

methods.name: setValuesWhereClause
methods.description: Binds values to an SQL statement for fields with non-null values, used in WHERE clauses.

methods.name: setPkValues
methods.description: Binds primary key values of an entity to an SQL statement.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves and converts a value from a ResultSet into an entity's field, handling various data types and encryption.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Binds a field value from an entity to an SQL statement, handling data types and encryption.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Maps Java type names to internal type codes used for JDBC operations.

methods.name: addValueSingle
methods.description: Appends a single value condition to an SQL condition string, with parameter binding support.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Appends a value or collection of values to an SQL condition string, supporting IN clauses.
